signature: SUBROUTINE DGBRFS( TRANS, N, KL, KU, NRHS, AB, LDAB, AFB, LDAFB,

params.name: trans
params.reference:
Specifies the form of the system of equations:

-   `= 'N'`: $A \, X = B$     (No transpose)
-   `= 'T'`: $A^T \, X = B$  (Transpose)
-   `= 'C'`: $A^H \, X = B$  (Conjugate transpose = Transpose)

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: kl
params.reference: The number of subdiagonals within the band of A. $\mathrm{KL} \ge 0$.

params.name: ku
params.reference: The number of superdiagonals within the band of A. $\mathrm{KU} \ge 0$.

params.name: nrhs
params.reference: The number of right hand sides, i.e., the number of columns of the matrices B and X. $\mathrm{NRHS} \ge 0$.

params.name: AB
params.reference: The original band matrix A, stored in rows 1 to `KL`+`KU`+1. The j-th column of A is stored in the j-th column of the array `AB` as follows: `AB(ku+1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $\max (1,j-\mathrm{ku}) \le i \le \min (n,j+\mathrm{kl})$.

params.name: ldab
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `AB`. $\mathrm{LDAB} \ge \mathrm{KL}+\mathrm{KU}+1$.

params.name: AFB
params.reference: Details of the LU factorization of the band matrix A, as computed by DGBTRF. U is stored as an upper triangular band matrix with `KL`+`KU` superdiagonals in rows 1 to `KL`+`KU`+1, and the multipliers used during the factorization are stored in rows `KL`+`KU`+2 to $2 \, \mathrm{KL}+\mathrm{KU}+1$.

params.name: ldafb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `AFB`. $\mathrm{LDAFB} \ge 2 \, \mathrm{KL} \, \mathrm{KU}+1$.

params.name: IPIV
params.reference: The pivot indices from DGBTRF; for $1 \le i \le N$, row i of the matrix was interchanged with row `IPIV(i)`.

params.name: B
params.reference: The right hand side matrix B.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: X
params.reference: On entry, the solution matrix X, as computed by DGBTRS. On exit, the improved solution matrix X.

params.name: ldx
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array X. $\mathrm{LDX} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: FERR
params.reference: The estimated forward error bound for each solution vector `X(j)` (the j-th column of the solution matrix X). If XTRUE is the true solution corresponding to `X(j)`, `FERR(j)` is an estimated upper bound for the magnitude of the largest element in (`X(j)` - XTRUE) divided by the magnitude of the largest element in `X(j)`. The estimate is as reliable as the estimate for RCOND, and is almost always a slight overestimate of the true error.

params.name: BERR
params.reference: The componentwise relative backward error of each solution vector `X(j)` (i.e., the smallest relative change in any element of A or B that makes `X(j)` an exact solution).

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
